title: The Quiet Winter
author: Orsen Zhou
blurb: Mara Dunmore, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. But when the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, they must hold out until sunrise with the truth about what was invited in before the frost writes its final pattern.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
